description: The bar chart compares the performance of different audio-language models on two benchmarks, MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR, with accuracy measured in percentage. The x-axis displays three model categories: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. For each model, two bars are shown: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR. The y-axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0 to 70%. The results show that Qwen2-Audio-Instruct achieves an accuracy of approximately 52% on MMAU and 32% on MMAR. Audio-Reasoner achieves around 62% on MMAU and 38% on MMAR. Qwen-2.5-Omni achieves the highest accuracy on both benchmarks, with approximately 65% on MMAU and 57% on MMAR. In all cases, the model performs better on MMAU than on MMAR.
